question: When should the installation of the linga be commenced relative to the appointed time?
premises: The linga installation must occur at a proper time.
Preparatory action precedes the exact moment.
A specific time unit before the muhūrta is indicated.
inference: One should begin the linga installation before the muhūrta-nāḍikā.
uncertainties: exact duration of nāḍikā in this context
plain_english: One should begin the installation of the linga before the appointed muhūrta-nāḍikā.
